full_judgment:
"Burden of proof whoever desires any Court to give judgment as to any legal right or liability dependent on the existence of facts which he asserts must prove that those facts exist. 

 When a person is bound to prove the existence of any fact, it is said that the burden of proof lies on that person." 

 21. Section 101 of the Evidence Act clearly Anisul Huq with ABM Golam Majid, states that the burden of proof lies on the person Advocates For the Appellant who asserts that a fact exists and exactly that view has been taken by the Hon'ble Court in the aforesaid case reported in 39 DLR 290.
